Let (M := \mathrm{rootedGram}\ G\ \mathit{weight}).  First obtain
(h_M : M.\mathrm{PosDef}) from
`PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.rootedGram_posDef_of_integer_positive G weight h_positive`.
For every rooted child (c) of (v), apply
`PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.rootedChildComponent_isAdmissible_of_unique_underweight`
to the edge from (v) to (c).  This supplies positive definiteness and the
invertibility of each child-component Gram block, while preserving the
capacity appearing in `rootedChildCapacitySummand`.

Split the index type into the singleton root (v) and its complement, and
reindex (M) to a block matrix
( egin{pmatrix}A&B\\B^{\dagger}&D\end{pmatrix}).
Use `Matrix.PosDef.submatrix` on (h_M) to make (D) positive definite,
hence invertible.  The root/root entry is (A_{vv}=(weight\ v:\mathbb Q)).
Unfold `rootedChildCapacitySum` and
`rootedChildCapacitySummand`; using the rooted-child component
partition and the component admissibility just obtained, calculate the
quadratic block term
((B D^{-1} B^{\dagger})_{vv}) as the finite sum of the component root
capacities, namely `rootedChildCapacitySum G hG weight v`.
This is the local block-diagonal/reindexing calculation corresponding to the
source's (sum_i\gamma_i).

Apply `Matrix.PosDef.fromBlocks₂₂` to the positive-semidefinite consequence
of (h_M) and the positive-definite lower-right block (D).  It yields
positive semidefiniteness of the one-by-one Schur complement
(S=A-BD^{-1}B^{\dagger}).  To upgrade the scalar conclusion to strict
positivity, use the defining strict quadratic-form clause of (h_M) on the
nonzero completion of the root basis vector after eliminating the nonroot
coordinates by (D^{-1}B^{\dagger}).  Simplification identifies that
strict quadratic value with the sole diagonal entry of (S).  Substitute the
two preceding identities and finish by linear arithmetic:
[
0 < (weight\ v:\mathbb Q)-\mathrm{rootedChildCapacitySum}\ G\ hG\ weight\ v,
]
which is equivalent to the required strict inequality.

-- lean-constellation: managed-imports-begin
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.IrreducibleVertex.Prelude
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Finite
-- lean-constellation: managed-imports-end

-- lean-constellation: declaration-source-begin

# lean-constellation target: `rootedChildCapacitySum_lt_weight_of_unique_underweight`

Let `V` be a finite type with decidable equality, let `G : SimpleGraph V` have decidable adjacency,
let `weight : V → ℤ`, and let `v : V`. Suppose `h_tree : G.IsTree`, `h_positive : ∀ x : V → ℤ, x ≠ 0
→ 0 < treePairing G weight x x`, `h_unique_underweight : ∃! u : V, weight u < (G.degree u : ℤ)`, `hv
: weight v < (G.degree v : ℤ)`, and `h_two : ∀ x : V, 2 ≤ weight x`. Then the canonical sum of the
capacities of the rooted child-side components at `v` is strictly below the integral weight at `v`,
viewed in `ℚ`:

`rootedChildCapacitySum G h_tree weight v < (weight v : ℚ)`.

## Sources

- Source `solution.tex`, lines 204–208

## Statement dependencies

- `SimpleGraph.IsTree` from `Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic`
- `SimpleGraph.degree` from `Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Finite`
- `Main.LatticeFoundations::treePairingAnchor` → `PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.treePairing` from
  `PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.LatticeFoundations.Defs.treePairingAnchor`
- `Main.RootedCapacity::rootedChildCapacitySum` → `rootedChildCapacitySum` from
  `PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedChildCapacitySum`
-/
lemma rootedChildCapacitySum_lt_weight_of_unique_underweight

    (h_positive : ∀ x : V → ℤ, x ≠ 0 →
      0 < PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.treePairing G weight x x)
    (h_unique_underweight : ∃! u : V, weight u < (G.degree u : ℤ))
    (hv : weight v < (G.degree v : ℤ)) (h_two : ∀ x : V, 2 ≤ weight x) :
    rootedChildCapacitySum G hG weight v < (weight v : ℚ) := by
